output.subject: Your suggestion about seeing which card was used in the app
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for getting in touch and for taking the time to share your suggestion with us.

You told us you noticed a charge described as "PP*GAMEVAULT DIGITAL" and, not recognizing it, worried that your card had been stolen. You mentioned that you then found out your son had bought a game, and that you are not disputing the charge. That must have been an unsettling moment before you got to the bottom of it, and we're glad you were able to find out what happened.

You also suggested that the app could show which card was used for each transaction, whether yours or the one on your son's phone, so it is easier to tell at a glance. We have received your message, and a specialist team is reviewing it. We will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you again for your feedback. It is helpful to hear how you use the app day to day.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer selected the Fraud topic but confirms the charge was made by their son and says they are not disputing it.
Confirm no fraud or dispute case was opened, or close it if one was.
This is mainly a feature suggestion, not a complaint; decide whether it needs a full response or a feedback acknowledgment.
Check how the son's card relates to the customer's account before describing any card or app features.
Decide whether to pass the app suggestion to the team that owns the app.
Customer also found the merchant name on the statement unclear; decide whether to address this.
